entries.2215c0f6448070af: It has accumulated technological development that led to the launch of the EcoCute, the world's first natural refrigerant (CO2) heat pump water heater, in 2001, and has repeatedly won the Energy Conservation Grand Prize. Its strengths also include production sites in Sanjo, Kashiwazaki and Nagaoka, a technology development center, and a structure in which the group handles everything from manufacturing through sales, installation and after-sales service.

entries.831ac141d57bc761: The company operates in a single segment of housing-related equipment. entries.fc54f4c348c8f856: Under the “2026 Vision,” which looks ahead to the 90th anniversary of its founding in 2027, it is advancing the 10th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027). Its three basic strategies are: restructuring its business portfolio toward a decarbonized society (expanding equipment that contributes to CO2 emission reduction and equipment with high resilience); expanding its business domain from “ease” to “enjoyment” through products and services that reduce household chores and products and services in the outdoor field; and restructuring its management base (reviewing internal systems and work practices and improving job fulfillment).
